The copy ran, but it skipped one folder.
However, the folder held cache files.
Although the cache was empty, the job retried it.
The retry passed, though it took an hour.
The disk was full, yet the job kept writing.
The old host kept its logs, whereas the new host deleted them.
The team nevertheless kept the new host.
The new host is nonetheless slower at night.
Even so, nobody filed a ticket.
The job finished despite the full disk.
The job finished in spite of two retries.
